page.layout: One printed page of marbled endpaper, no text block. Two paper labels or stamps on the right edge: an upper one with fragments of handwriting or print ("qun", "ang"), and a middle one with "...B. IIII" and "...wesentlich". A lower faded label is illegible. None of these is transcribed.
page.notes: Marbled paper (green, pink, black, yellow, white) covers the whole scan. Paper labels on the right edge are cut and faded; their legible fragments are "B. IIII" and "wesentlich", but they are shelf or library marks and are left out, as are the illegible remains of the lower label. No printed text belongs to this page.
